#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    long long n, m;
    std::cin >> n >> m;
    if (n > m) std::swap(n, m);

    long long sol = 0;

    if (m < 3) {
        std::cout << sol << std::endl;
        return 0;
    }

    if (n == 1) {
        sol = m % 6;
        if (sol > 3) sol = 6 - sol;
        std::cout << m - sol << std::endl;
        return 0;
    }

    if (n == 2) {
        sol = m * n;
        if (m == 3) sol = 4;
        if (m == 7) sol = 12;
    } else if (n == 3) {
        sol = m * n;
        if (m % 2 == 1) sol -= 1;
    } else {
        if (m % 2 == 1 && n % 2 == 1) sol = m * n - 1;
        else sol = m * n;
    }

    std::cout << sol << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
